//@version=5
strategy("RSI Mean-Reversion", overlay=true, default_qty_type=strategy.percent_of_equity, default_qty_value=2)

// Inputs
rsiLen   = input.int(14, "RSI Length")
oversold = input.int(30, "Oversold")
bought   = input.int(70, "Overbought")
riskPct  = input.float(1.0, "Risk % per trade", step=0.25)

// Signals
rsi      = ta.rsi(close, rsiLen)
longSig  = ta.crossover(rsi, oversold)
exitSig  = ta.crossunder(rsi, bought)

// Position sizing from a fixed % stop
stopDist = ta.atr(14) * 1.5
qty      = (strategy.equity * riskPct / 100) / stopDist

if longSig and strategy.position_size == 0
    strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long, qty=qty)
    strategy.exit("Stop", "Long", stop=close - stopDist)

if exitSig
    strategy.close("Long")

// Fire a webhook alert your bot can route to your broker
alertcondition(longSig, "BUY", '{"side":"buy","symbol":"{{ticker}}"}')
caption: A complete TradingView strategy: RSI crossover entry, ATR-based position sizing, and an alertcondition() whose JSON payload your bot forwards to your broker connector.
